decision.reason: [ev-7af9fcb7190e] is a single release-note sentence. It says the Helm chart can now add custom annotations to the revision-tag MutatingWebhookConfiguration, which is an opt-in addition. It does not name the chart or the Helm values key that controls this. The file name hints at sidecarInjectorWebhook, but that is not a stated values path, so neither the subject nor the applicability condition can be written as a typed assertion. The chart's values.yaml or the webhook template diff for the revision-tag configuration is needed to fix the key.
